mapper.sql: c.id, c.sender_id, c.receiver_id, c.image, c.content, c.send_time, c.status, c.comment_type, su.username as sender_name, su.avatar as sender_avatar, ru.username as receiver_name, ru.avatar as receiver_avatar
mapper.insert: insert into comment (sender_id, receiver_id, image, content, send_time, status, comment_type) values (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{image}, #{content}, #{sendTime}, #{status}, #{commentType})
mapper.select:
select
from comment c left join user su on c.sender_id = su.id left join user ru on c.receiver_id = ru.id where c.sender_id = #{senderId} order by c.send_time desc

select
from comment c left join user su on c.sender_id = su.id left join user ru on c.receiver_id = ru.id where c.receiver_id = #{receiverId} and c.status = #{status} order by c.send_time desc
